comment: fix: Restore short-circuit semantics in Vega-Lite expressions and warn and exclude rows when filter evaluation fails. Removing all rows retains mark-specific empty-data behavior: nonaggregate bar charts throw synchronously during rendering, while scatter charts support a no-data display. Previously rendered specs can now throw, including an entire concatenated chart when a child fails. Callers needing containment must handle render errors externally. Filters remain display-only, not authorization controls.
